title: Stylish Men's Outfit Ideas | Trending Fashion Look
prompt:
ULTRA-REALISTIC MEN'S AESTHETIC FASHION COLLAGE — RELAXED CASUAL STREET STYLE
Create an ultra-realistic, high-resolution men's fashion photography collage featuring the same young adult man from the uploaded reference image in six different natural poses against a clean, warm off-white studio background.
The overall aesthetic should feel relaxed, minimal, masculine, modern, and effortlessly stylish, resembling a premium Pinterest fashion lookbook captured by a professional photographer.
STRICT FACIAL IDENTITY PRESERVATION:
Use the uploaded portrait as the ONLY facial identity reference. Preserve the exact face shape, eyes, eyebrows, nose, lips, jawline, beard, hairstyle, hairline, skin tone, and natural facial texture across all six poses. Do not beautify, reshape, smooth, or replace the face.
OUTFIT — RELAXED NEUTRAL AESTHETIC:
- Upper: Oversized soft mocha-brown knitted polo T-shirt with an open collar, short sleeves, relaxed shoulders, and subtle textured fabric.
- Bottom: Cream-beige wide-leg trousers with a relaxed straight silhouette, natural pleats, and soft fabric folds.
- Footwear: Clean off-white retro sneakers with subtle beige detailing.
- Accessories: Minimal silver wristwatch, thin silver bracelet, and dark-brown rectangular sunglasses.
- Bag: Small chocolate-brown leather crossbody bag with a minimal design, worn casually over one shoulder or carried naturally in one hand.
The outfit must remain exactly consistent across all six poses. Maintain natural fabric textures, believable clothing movement, and realistic proportions.
SIX NATURAL FASHION POSES:
POSE 1 — UPPER LEFT: CASUAL SELFIE
The man stands comfortably, holding a black smartphone slightly above face level with one hand. His other hand rests naturally inside his trouser pocket. Relaxed shoulders, slight head tilt, and a subtle smile.
POSE 2 — UPPER CENTER: BACK VIEW
Standing with his back toward the camera, showing the relaxed drape of the oversized knitted polo and wide-leg trousers. His head turns slightly to one side, naturally revealing his hairstyle.
POSE 3 — UPPER RIGHT: SUNGLASSES MOMENT
A three-quarter side-profile portrait. He casually adjusts his sunglasses with one hand while looking slightly downward. Calm expression, natural posture, and realistic hand placement.
POSE 4 — MIDDLE LEFT: RELAXED WALKING
Full-body walking pose captured naturally mid-stride. One hand inside his trouser pocket while the other carries the small brown leather bag. Realistic clothing movement and relaxed body language.
POSE 5 — MIDDLE RIGHT: PHONE CALL
Walking slowly while holding a smartphone near his ear. His head turns slightly sideways with a natural conversational expression. One foot moves forward, creating authentic candid movement.
POSE 6 — BOTTOM: EDITORIAL DETAIL POSE
A partially cropped seated or leaning pose, showing the knitted polo texture, wristwatch, bag, and relaxed trouser silhouette. One arm rests naturally across his body, creating a spontaneous fashion-editorial moment.
BACKGROUND & COLLAGE ARRANGEMENT:
Use a clean, warm ivory-white seamless studio background with very subtle cream undertones.
Arrange six photographs in a stylish, asymmetrical fashion collage:
Three smaller portraits across the upper section, two larger full-body walking photographs through the middle, and one expressive cropped pose near the bottom.
Allow subtle visual overlap between figures while maintaining realistic body proportions and clear separation.
No borders, frames, typography, or decorative graphics.
LIGHTING & CAMERA:
Soft diffused daylight-style studio lighting with natural shadows and gentle highlights. Warm-neutral color grading, realistic skin tones, and subtle depth.
Professional full-frame DSLR photography, 50mm portrait lens, natural perspective, sharp facial details, authentic cotton and knitted fabric textures, realistic leather materials, and subtle photographic imperfections.
COMPOSITION:
Vertical 3:4 aspect ratio. Six distinct poses, balanced spacing, varied framing, consistent facial identity, and natural movement.
FINAL AESTHETIC:
Relaxed men's fashion, neutral outfits, Pinterest aesthetic, minimal streetwear, casual luxury, natural confidence, clean studio photography, realistic textures, and premium fashion lookbook styling.
NEGATIVE PROMPT:
Different faces, altered facial identity, inconsistent hairstyle, changing outfit colors, artificial muscles, exaggerated body proportions, stiff poses, extra fingers, duplicated limbs, unnatural walking movement, distorted shoes, floating accessories, excessive HDR, plastic skin, CGI appearance, oversaturation, text, logos, watermarks, and messy collage layout.

title: I can do this all day
prompt:
PROMPT:
Use my uploaded original photo as the primary reference. Transform me into a powerful, cinematic, black-and-white motivational poster inspired by the reference image.
Identity preservation: Keep my real face, facial structure, skin tone, hairstyle, and recognizable features as close to my original photo as possible. Make the result photorealistic, not cartoonish.
Pose and composition: Show me as a determined young man climbing or gripping the side of a tall, weathered industrial structure, one arm stretched upward holding a metal beam and my body leaning diagonally with a strong, athletic posture. Capture a dramatic low-angle, full-body shot that conveys courage, ambition, struggle, and determination. Keep the pose physically believable.
Outfit: Dark, fitted athletic T-shirt, dark trousers, realistic fabric textures, subtle muscle definition, natural body proportions.
Environment: A towering, abandoned industrial building on the right, dramatic storm clouds in the background, mist drifting through the sky, subtle atmospheric particles, deep shadows, and a faint glow of light breaking through the clouds behind me.
Lighting and color grading: Ultra-dramatic monochrome black-and-white photography, deep blacks, bright silver highlights, strong rim lighting outlining my face and body, high contrast, detailed shadows, film-grain texture, dark cinematic atmosphere, premium editorial photography.
Typography: Add enormous, elegant, condensed serif typography behind my body. Top line: “I CAN DO”. Bottom line: “THIS ALL DAY”. Use tall white uppercase letters with a distressed, weathered texture. Let my body naturally overlap parts of the letters for a professional layered-poster effect. Keep all words correctly spelled, readable, and aligned.
Image quality: Photorealistic, ultra-detailed skin and fabric, sharp subject focus, realistic anatomy, dramatic depth, professional movie-poster composition, 4K-quality finish, vertical 9:16 aspect ratio, optimized for a mobile wallpaper or Instagram Story.
Important: Use my uploaded photo for my identity, not the person in the reference. Avoid extra fingers, distorted limbs, duplicated body parts, blurry facial features, colorful lighting, cartoon effects, watermarks, logos, and additional text.

title: Don't quit
prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the primary style and composition reference. Create a vertical 9:16 monochrome dark fantasy portrait featuring a mysterious young male warrior, inspired by the reference image.
Main character: A handsome young man with a sharp, natural masculine face, slightly messy long black hair partially covering his eyes, pale monochrome skin tones, and a calm, cold, emotionless expression. He wears a deep black hood and an intricately detailed medieval dark-fantasy armored outfit with layered metal plates, engraved patterns, distressed textures, sharp ornamental shoulder armor, and a flowing dark cloak. A thin silver cross necklace hangs over his chest.
Background character: Behind him, add a gigantic, faded, ghostly portrait of the same male character, with long hair covering his eyes and a mysterious expression. Surround the background portrait with a broken, spiked halo resembling an ancient celestial crown.
Composition: The main warrior occupies the center and lower portion of the frame, shown from the waist up. The enormous faded face fills the left background. Leave generous clean white negative space in the upper portion for typography.
Typography: Add elegant, high-fashion editorial serif text near the top reading “Don't” on the first line and “Quit.” on the second line. Use bold black typography with subtle motion blur on selected letters, creating an artistic, mysterious editorial effect.
Visual style: Pure black, white, and silver-gray palette, gothic elegance, dark anime realism, detailed pencil-like textures, cinematic shadows, ethereal atmosphere, fine grain, delicate mist, high contrast, luxurious magazine-cover composition, ultra-detailed armor, sharp focus on the main character, professional art direction, 4K quality.
Important: Keep the image sophisticated and masculine. Avoid bright colors, exaggerated muscles, cartoonish proportions, excessive glow, and clutter. Preserve the reference image's overall composition, typography placement, and monochromatic aesthetic. Vertical 9:16 wallpaper, high resolution.
